name: poptart
title: poptart
tagline: A local Strudel live-coding studio: write patterns, hit Play, and let your Hermes agent compose alongside you.
display_name_note: Always call this plugin poptart in the showcase. The catalog listing title is Hermes Strudel Studio and the catalog id is hermes-strudel-studio, but the product name is poptart.

stats.tokens_note: README: one composable agent tool, poptart_studio, covers 11 ops behind a single {op, input} call, with a 127-token schema (o200k_base).

tests.note: README Testing section: npm test (Node service tests, 7); python -m pytest -q tests/plugin (Python plugin tests, 12). Additional Playwright / desktop / standalone / browser suites are documented without a single combined count.

features: Live-coding Strudel/JS editor with tempo, Play/apply, Stop, and Mute
Scheduler-synced mini-notation highlights in the Hermes accent
Invalid edits keep the last good pattern playing and show the error separately
Persistent track library with revisions, snapshots, and named sections
One composable tool, poptart_studio, plus an opt-in Desktop/Webapp pane
Local-first: loopback-only Node sidecar, private per-install token, no hosted AI service
use_cases: Write a Strudel pattern in the studio and press Play; nothing sounds until you do
Ask Hermes to draft a beat, add a break, or change the tempo through poptart_studio, then apply it yourself
Keep several tracks with snapshots and switch named sections such as Intro, Main, or Break
Watch tokens light up as they play, then edit without killing the groove if the new code is invalid
Use the right-hand library layout shown in the README screenshots
Run the studio as a standalone app (Node 22+) or as the catalog subdirectory integration/hermes
install:
The installable plugin is the self-contained integration/hermes directory, not the repo root. Catalog installs need Node 22+, not npm or a local build.

hermes plugins install mojomast/poptart --ref 42356ddb9eff2eea2419bbd223ee159f353e4632
# once listed, the catalog name is hermes-strudel-studio:
# hermes plugins install hermes-strudel-studio --enable
hermes plugins enable hermes-strudel-studio
